name: Agent governance review
status: repository prototype only; not a Fabric item definition
purpose: Ground agent-governance reviews in DataHub's existing business keys and source-owned measures.

entities.name: Agent activity
entities.grain: Use the semantic model's measures; do not count fact rows as conversations.

entities.name: Person
entities.privacy: Use identity only for governed ownership and filtering; do not return person-level activity.

entities.name: Agent evaluation
entities.grain: One evaluated conversation; use the model's aggregate measures.

relationships.name: agent-creator-to-person
relationships.status: requires adding Agent creator UPN from the source table to the semantic model; not present in the current template
relationships.resolution: Normalize the creator UPN like PersonId_Normalized and validate a unique match before binding.

relationships.name: configuration-to-agent
relationships.status: optional Resource Graph source; validate in the target model

relationships.name: agent-owner-to-person
relationships.status: optional owner detail; validate availability and permissions
relationships.resolution: Normalize the owner UPN like PersonId_Normalized and validate a unique match before binding.

relationships.name: evaluation-to-agent
relationships.status: requires canonical identity enrichment before binding
relationships.resolution: Reuse the canonical Title ID rules in core/valuelens_core/agent_link.py, but require a unique canonical candidate for each Bot ID. The existing Bot Id map chooses a preferred row and does not by itself establish uniqueness. Keep unmatched or ambiguous IDs unlinked.

sourceOwnedMeasures.audienceNote: [Unique Users] can count a blank UPN. For the minimum-audience rule, count distinct nonblank UPNs after trimming and case normalization.

identityRules: Use Title ID as the registered-agent key and preserve the existing LOB/Shared canonicalization.
Use BotId as the evaluation identity input; check for exactly one canonical Title ID before linking.
Never join Agent name, BotName, or BotFriendlyName to a registry name; display names are not unique.
Keep records with missing or ambiguous identity visible as unlinked rather than guessing.

deferredSignals.status: defer until its identity and grain are validated against the canonical agent key

guardrails.status: requirements for a future implementation; not enforced by this prototype
